vetSays.line: 🛡️ Mabel, Tancredi, Ayishetu and Sari met them at the door — 4 put down. Tancredi, Ayishetu, Sari are hurt.
🛡️ Tancredi, Ayishetu, Sari and Sofia met them at the door — 4 put down. Tancredi, Ayishetu, Sari, Sofia are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Leo just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Carl, Ayishetu, Sofia, Dmitri and Ines met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Carl, Ayishetu, Sofia, Dmitri, Ines are hurt.
🛡️ Ayishetu, Sari, Sofia, Dmitri and Nathan met them at the door — 2 put down, 3 barely walked away. Ayishetu, Sari, Sofia, Dmitri, Nathan are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ayishetu just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sari just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ayishetu, Sari, Sofia and Dmitri met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Ayishetu, Sofia, Dmitri are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sari just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
🛡️ Ethan met them at the door — 1 put down. Ethan is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lena just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hassan just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Lena and Hassan met them at the door — 2 put down. Lena, Hassan are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lena just put down The Influencer... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

Ifeanyi: "Lena and Ayishetu blooded the fourth draft's beasts — we all saw it on the cameras. But only 5 of us carry a weapon, and the fifth draft waits until 6 of us do. We need more hands armed, not more speeches."
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Nathan was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Zewge taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Zewge is showing everyone Ground Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
💡 Ground Elder: the village and Thornfield know more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
Zewge: "Walked past a good stand of ground elder. Worth remembering where."
